proof_body:
by
  intro a w ha
  set b : ℂ := (a : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * w * Complex.I with hb
  set c : ℂ := (a : ℂ) - 2 * Real.pi * w * Complex.I with hc
  have hbre : 0 < b.re := by simp [hb, ha]
  have hcre : 0 < c.re := by simp [hc, ha]
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (Real.exp (-a * |v|) : ℂ)
  have eR : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F v = Complex.exp ((-b) * v) := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [F]
    rw [abs_of_pos hv, Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [hb]
    push_cast
    ring
  have eL : ∀ v ∈ Set.Iic (0:ℝ), F v = Complex.exp (c * v) := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [F]
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hv, Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [hc]
    push_cast
    ring
  have iR : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn F (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    refine (integrableOn_exp_mul_complex_Ioi (a := -b) (by simpa using hbre) 0).congr_fun (fun v hv => (eR v hv).symm) measurableSet_Ioi
  have iL : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn F (Set.Iic 0) := by
    refine (integrableOn_exp_mul_complex_Iic hcre 0).congr_fun (fun v hv => (eL v hv).symm) measurableSet_Iic
  have hsplit := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi iL iR
  change ∫ v : ℝ, F v = _
  rw [← hsplit, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic eL, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi eR, integral_exp_mul_complex_Iic hcre, integral_exp_mul_complex_Ioi (by simpa using hbre)]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero]
  have hbne : b ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hbre
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hcre
  have hprod : b * c = ((a ^ 2 + 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * w ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp only [hb, hc]
    push_cast
    ring_nf
    rw [Complex.I_sq]
    ring
  have hsum : b + c = 2 * (a : ℂ) := by simp only [hb, hc]; ring
  rw [Complex.ofReal_div, ← hprod]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  exact hsum
target_source: ∀ a w : ℝ, 0 < a → ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (Real.exp (-a * |v|) : ℂ) = ((2 * a / (a ^ 2 + 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * w ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
